options.misconception: confuses imeil with sillyehamnida from a different sense
confuses imeil with hwanyeonghamnida from a different sense
confuses imeil with baek from a different sense

questions.explanation: Despite the near-form confusions, '이메일' itself means 'email'. A fails because confuses imeil with sillyehamnida from a different sense; B is correct because it gives email; C fails because confuses imeil with hwanyeonghamnida from a different sense; D fails because confuses imeil with baek from a different sense.
